executedQuery:
_sourceCategory=formstack/prod/*
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| json field=_raw "context.formId" as formId
| where formId = "6321476"
| count message

records.aiComments: Logs when submission updated events are processed by the OpenSearch data integrity system. This occurs when the system handles submission update events to maintain search index consistency and update modified submissions in search indexes. Includes submission details for tracking submission update event processing, monitoring search index updates, and ensuring proper OpenSearch data synchronization when submissions are modified in the system.

Logs successful loading of reports in the system. This occurs when users access reports and the system successfully loads report data and configurations. Includes report ID for tracking report access activities, monitoring report usage patterns, and ensuring proper report functionality and user experience across different report types and access methods.

Logs successful updates to submission settings or properties. This occurs when users or administrators modify submission configurations such as submission status, notes, or other submission properties. Includes field name and submission ID for tracking submission configuration changes, monitoring submission management activities, and ensuring proper submission setting updates and audit trails across different submission types and configuration changes.

Logs completion of form submission count synchronization operations. This occurs when background jobs finish updating form submission counters to ensure data consistency. Includes sync details for tracking submission count accuracy, monitoring data synchronization performance, and ensuring proper form analytics and reporting data integrity across the platform.

Logs when submission created events are dispatched to the event system for processing. This occurs when new form submissions are created and the system dispatches events to notify other components about the submission creation. Includes submission ID for tracking submission event dispatching, monitoring event system processing, and ensuring proper submission event handling and notification across different submission types and event processing scenarios.
